verses.text: Isaac call Jacob, bless am, and command am, talk to am say, “You no go take wife from di pikin woman dem of Canaan.
Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to di house of Bethuel your mama papa, and take wife from dere from di pikin woman dem of Laban your mama brother.
God Almighty bless you, make you fruitful, and multiply you, so that you go become company of peoples,
and give you di blessing of Abraham, to you and to your seed with you, so that you go inherit di land wia you dey stranger, wey God give to Abraham.”
Isaac send Jacob away. E go to Paddan Aram, to Laban, di pikin of Bethuel di Syrian, di brother of Rebekah, Jacob and Esau mama.
Now Esau see say Isaac don bless Jacob and send am away to Paddan Aram to take wife from dere, and say as e bless am, e command am say, “You no go take wife from di pikin woman dem of Canaan,”
and say Jacob obey im papa and im mama, and go to Paddan Aram.
Esau see say di pikin woman dem of Canaan no good for Isaac im papa eyes.
Esau go to Ishmael, and take Mahalath, di pikin woman of Ishmael, Abraham pikin, di sister of Nebaioth, to be im wife, besides im wives wey e get.
Jacob leave Beersheba, and go toward Haran.
E reach one place, and stay dere all night, because di sun don set. E take one of di stones of di place, put am under im head, and lie down for dat place to sleep.
E dream, and look, one ladder set up on di earth, and im top reach heaven. Look, di angels of God dey go up and come down on am.
Look, di Lord stand above am, talk say, “I na di Lord, di God of Abraham your papa, and di God of Isaac. Di land wia you dey lie, I go give am to you and to your seed.
Your seed go be like di dust of di earth, and you go spread abroad to di west, and to di east, and to di north, and to di south. For you and for your seed all di families of di earth go dey blessed.
Look, I dey with you, and I go keep you wherever you go, and I go bring you again into dis land. I no go leave you, until I don do wetin I talk to you.”
Jacob wake from im sleep, and e talk say, “Surely di Lord dey for dis place, and I no know.”
E fear, and talk say, “How awesome dis place be! Dis na none other but God house, and dis na di gate of heaven.”
Jacob rise up early for morning, take di stone wey e put under im head, set am up for pillar, and pour oil on top of am.
E call di name of dat place Bethel, but di name of di city na Luz at di first.
Jacob make vow, talk say, “If God go dey with me, and go keep me for dis way wey I dey go, and go give me bread to eat and clothing to wear,
so that I come again to my papa house in peace, di Lord go be my God.
Dis stone, wey I don set up for pillar, go be God house. Of all wey you go give me I go surely give di tenth to you.”
Den Jacob go on im journey, and come to di land of di pikin dem of di east.
E look, and see one well for di field, and look, three flocks of sheep lie dere by am, because for dat well dem dey water di flocks. Di stone for di well mouth big.
Dem dey gather all di flocks dere. Dem go roll di stone from di well mouth, water di sheep, and put di stone again on di well mouth for im place.
Jacob talk to dem say, “My brothers, wia una come from?” Dem talk say, “We come from Haran.”
E talk to dem say, “Una know Laban, di pikin of Nahor?” Dem talk say, “We know am.”
E talk to dem say, “E dey well with am?” Dem talk say, “E dey well. Look, Rachel im pikin woman dey come with di sheep.”
E talk say, “Look, e still dey high day. Na no time to gather di livestock together. Water di sheep, and go feed dem.”
Dem talk say, “We no fit, until all di flocks gather together, and dem roll di stone from di well mouth. Den we go water di sheep.”
While e still dey talk with dem, Rachel come with im papa sheep, because e dey tend dem.

E come be say, when Jacob see Rachel, di pikin woman of Laban im mama brother, and di sheep of Laban im mama brother, Jacob go near, roll di stone from di well mouth, and water di flock of Laban im mama brother.
Jacob kiss Rachel, lift up im voice, and weep.
Jacob tell Rachel say e na im papa relative, and say e na Rebekah pikin. Rachel run tell im papa.
E come be say, when Laban hear di news of Jacob im sister pikin, e run to meet am, embrace am, kiss am, and bring am to im house. E tell Laban all dis things.
Laban talk to am say, “Surely you na my bone and my flesh.” E stay with am for one month.
Laban talk to Jacob say, “Because you na my relative, you go serve me for nothing? Tell me, wetin your wages go be?”
Laban get two pikin woman dem. Di name of di older na Leah, and di name of di younger na Rachel.
Leah eyes dey weak, but Rachel fine to look at and beautiful.
Jacob love Rachel. E talk say, “I go serve you seven years for Rachel your younger pikin woman.”
Laban talk say, “Better make I give am to you than make I give am to another man. Stay with me.”
Jacob serve seven years for Rachel, and dem dey seem to am like few days, because of di love wey e get for am.
Jacob talk to Laban say, “Give me my wife, because my days don complete, make I go in to am.”
Laban gather together all di men of di place, and make feast.
E come be say for evening, e take Leah im pikin woman, and bring am to am, and e go in to am.
Laban give im servant Zilpah to im pikin woman Leah for servant.
E come be say for morning, look, e na Leah. E talk to Laban say, “Wetin be dis wey you don do to me? I no serve with you for Rachel? Why you don deceive me?”
Laban talk say, “Dem no dey do so for our place, to give di younger before di firstborn.
Complete di week of dis one, and we go give you di other too for di service wey you go serve with me yet seven other years.”
Jacob do so, and complete di week of dis one. Laban give am Rachel im pikin woman to be im wife.
Laban give im servant Bilhah to im pikin woman Rachel to be im servant.
Jacob go in to Rachel too, and e love Rachel more pass Leah, and e serve with am yet seven other years.
Di Lord see say dem hate Leah, and e open im womb, but Rachel no born pikin.
Leah become pregnant, and born one pikin man, and e call im name Reuben, because e talk say, “Because di Lord don look my affliction. Now my husband go love me.”
E become pregnant again, and born one pikin man, and talk say, “Because di Lord don hear say dem hate me, e don give me dis one too.” E call im name Simeon.
E become pregnant again, and born one pikin man, and talk say, “Now dis time my husband go join to me, because I don born am three pikin man dem.” Na why dem call im name Levi.
E become pregnant again, and born one pikin man, and talk say, “Dis time I go praise di Lord.” Na why e call im name Judah. Den e stop to born.
When Rachel see say e no born pikin for Jacob, Rachel envy im sister. E talk to Jacob say, “Give me pikin dem, or else I go die.”
Jacob anger burn against Rachel, and e talk say, “Na me dey God place, wey don stop you from di fruit of di womb?”
E talk say, “Look, my servant Bilhah. Go in to am, so that e go born for my knees, and I too go get pikin dem by am.”
E give am Bilhah im servant to be wife, and Jacob go in to am.
Bilhah become pregnant, and born Jacob one pikin man.
Rachel talk say, “God don judge me, and e don hear my voice too, and e don give me one pikin man.” Na why e call im name Dan.
Bilhah, Rachel servant, become pregnant again, and born Jacob di second pikin man.
Rachel talk say, “With great wrestling I don wrestle with my sister, and I don prevail.” E call im name Naphtali.
When Leah see say e don stop to born, e take Zilpah im servant, and give am to Jacob to be wife.
Zilpah, Leah servant, born Jacob one pikin man.
Leah talk say, “Good fortune dey come!” E call im name Gad.
Zilpah, Leah servant, born Jacob di second pikin man.
Leah talk say, “I dey happy, because di women go call me happy.” E call im name Asher.
Reuben go for di days of wheat harvest, find mandrakes for di field, and bring dem to im mama Leah. Den Rachel talk to Leah say, “Give me some of your pikin mandrakes.”
E talk to am say, “E small matter say you don take my husband? You go take away my pikin mandrakes too?” Rachel talk say, “Den e go sleep with you tonight for your pikin mandrakes.”
Jacob come from di field for evening, and Leah go out to meet am, talk say, “You must come in to me, because I don hire you surely with my pikin mandrakes.” E sleep with am dat night.
God listen to Leah, and e become pregnant, and born Jacob di fifth pikin man.
Leah talk say, “God don give me my wages, because I give my servant to my husband.” E call im name Issachar.
Leah become pregnant again, and born Jacob di sixth pikin man.
Leah talk say, “God don give me good gift. Now my husband go dwell with me, because I don born am six pikin man dem.” E call im name Zebulun.
Afterward e born one pikin woman, and call im name Dinah.
God remember Rachel, and God listen to am, and open im womb.
E become pregnant, and born one pikin man, and talk say, “God don take away my reproach.”
E call im name Joseph, talk say, “Di Lord go add to me another pikin man.”
E come be say when Rachel don born Joseph, Jacob talk to Laban say, “Send me away, so that I go go to my own place, and to my country.
Give me my wives and my pikin dem, wey I don serve you for, and make I go, because you know my service wey I don do for you.”
Laban talk to am say, “If now I don find favour for your eyes, stay. I don learn by divination say di Lord don bless me for your sake.”
E talk say, “Name your wages, and I go give am.”
E talk to am say, “You know how I don serve you, and how your livestock don dey with me.
Because di little wey you get before I come don increase to multitude, and di Lord don bless you wherever I turn. Now when I go provide for my own house too?”
E talk say, “Wetin I go give you?” Jacob talk say, “You no go give me anything. If you go do dis one thing for me, I go again feed your flock and keep am.
I go pass through all your flock today, remove from dere every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among di sheep, and di spotted and speckled among di goats. Dem go be my wages.

So my righteousness go answer for me for time to come, when you come about my wages wey dey before you. If e no speckled and spotted among di goats, and black among di sheep, make dem count am as stolen with me.”
Laban talk say, “Look, make e be according to your word.”

For dat day e remove di male goats wey get stripes and wey dey spotted, and all di female goats wey dey speckled and spotted, every one wey get white for am, and all di black among di sheep, and give dem into di hand of im pikin dem.
E set three days journey between imself and Jacob. Jacob feed di rest of Laban flocks.
Jacob take rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, and peel white streaks for dem, expose di white wey dey di rods.
E set di rods wey e peel for di gutters, for di watering troughs wia di flocks dey come to drink, before di flocks, and dem go mate when dem come to drink.
Di flocks mate before di rods, and di flocks bring forth striped, speckled, and spotted.
Jacob separate di lambs, and set di faces of di flocks toward di striped and all di black for di flock of Laban. E put im own herds by demself, and no put dem with Laban flock.
E come be say whenever di stronger of di flock mate, Jacob lay di rods before di eyes of di flock for di gutters, so that dem go mate among di rods;
but when di flock feeble, e no put dem. So di feebler go be Laban own, and di stronger Jacob own.
Di man increase exceedingly, and get plenty flocks, and female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
Jacob hear di words of Laban pikin dem, wey talk say, “Jacob don take all wey belong to our papa. From wetin belong to our papa e don get all dis wealth.”
Jacob see di face of Laban, and look, e no dey toward am as before.
Di Lord talk to Jacob say, “Return to di land of your papa dem, and to your relatives, and I go dey with you.”
Jacob send and call Rachel and Leah to di field to im flock,
and talk to dem say, “I see your papa face, say e no dey toward me as before; but di God of my papa don dey with me.
You know say with all my strength I don serve your papa.
Your papa don deceive me, and change my wages ten times, but God no allow am to hurt me.
If e talk say, ‘Di speckled go be your wages,’ all di flock born speckled; and if e talk say, ‘Di striped go be your wages,’ all di flock born striped.
Na so God don take away your papa livestock, and give dem to me.
E come be say for di time wey di flock mate, I lift up my eyes, and see for dream, and look, di male goats wey dey mate dey striped, speckled, and spotted.
Di angel of God talk to me for di dream say, ‘Jacob,’ and I talk say, ‘Here I dey.’
E talk say, ‘Lift up your eyes now, and see, all di male goats wey dey mate dey striped, speckled, and spotted, because I don see all wey Laban dey do to you.
I na di God of Bethel, wia you anoint pillar, wia you make vow to me. Now arise, leave dis land, and return to di land of your birth.’”
Rachel and Leah answer am, talk say, “Portion or inheritance still dey for us for our papa house?
Dem no count us as foreigners? Because e don sell us, and e don also devour our money.
Surely all di riches wey God don take from our papa na ours and our pikin dem own. Now then, whatever God don talk to you, do am.”
Den Jacob rise up, set im pikin dem and im wives on di camels,
and e carry away all im livestock, and all im goods wey e don get, di livestock wey e get for Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac im papa for di land of Canaan.
Now Laban don go to shear im sheep. Rachel steal di household gods wey belong to im papa.
Jacob deceive Laban di Syrian, say e no tell am say e dey run.
So e run with all wey e get. E rise up, cross di River, and set im face toward di mountain of Gilead.
Dem tell Laban for di third day say Jacob don run.
E take im relatives with am, and chase am seven days journey, and e overtake am for di mountain of Gilead.
God come to Laban di Syrian for dream for night, talk to am say, “Beware say you no speak to Jacob either good or bad.”
Laban overtake Jacob. Now Jacob don pitch im tent for di mountain, and Laban with im relatives pitch for di mountain of Gilead.
Laban talk to Jacob say, “Wetin you don do, say you don deceive me, and carry away my pikin woman dem like captives of di sword?
Why you run away secretly, and deceive me, and no tell me, so that I for send you away with joy and with songs, with tambourine and with harp?
You no allow me kiss my pikin dem and my pikin woman dem. Now you don do foolishly.
E dey for di power of my hand to do you harm, but di God of your papa talk to me last night, say, ‘Beware say you no speak to Jacob either good or bad.’
Now you don go, because you really long for your papa house. But why you steal my gods?”
Jacob answer Laban, “Because I dey afraid, for I talk say, ‘Maybe you go take your pikin woman dem from me by force.’
Whoever you find your gods with no go live. Before our relatives, identify wetin dey with me wey be your own, and take am.” For Jacob no know say Rachel don steal dem.
Laban enter Jacob tent, Leah tent, and di two female servants tents, but e no find dem. E go out of Leah tent, and enter Rachel tent.
Now Rachel don take di household gods, put dem inside di camel saddle, and sit on dem. Laban search all di tent, but e no find dem.
E talk to im papa say, “Make my oga no vex say I no fit rise up before you, because di way of women dey with me.” E search, but e no find di household gods.
Jacob vex, and quarrel with Laban. Jacob answer Laban say, “Wetin be my trespass? Wetin be my sin, say you don chase me so hot?
Though you don search all my goods, wetin you find of all your household goods? Put am here before my relatives and your relatives, so that dem go judge between us two.
Dis 20 years I don dey with you. Your ewes and your female goats no miscarry, and I no eat di rams of your flocks.
Wetin wild animals tear, I no bring am to you. I bear di loss of am. You demand am of my hand, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
Na so I dey. For day di heat consume me, and di frost for night, and my sleep leave my eyes.
Dis 20 years I don dey for your house. I serve you 14 years for your two pikin woman dem, and six years for your flock, and you don change my wages ten times.

If di God of my papa, di God of Abraham, and di Fear of Isaac, no dey with me, surely now you for don send me away empty. God don see my affliction and di labour of my hands, and e rebuke you last night.”

Laban answer Jacob, “Di pikin woman dem na my pikin woman dem, and di pikin dem na my pikin dem, and di flocks na my flocks, and all wey you see na mine. Wetin I fit do today to dem my pikin woman dem, or to dem pikin wey dem don born?
Now come, make we make covenant, you and me, and make e be witness between you and me.”
Jacob take one stone, and set am up for pillar.
Jacob talk to im relatives say, “Gather stones.” Dem take stones, and make heap, and dem eat dere by di heap.
Laban call am Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob call am Galeed.
Laban talk say, “Dis heap na witness between me and you today.” Na why e call im name Galeed,
and Mizpah, because e talk say, “Make di Lord watch between me and you, when we dey absent one from another.
If you go afflict my pikin woman dem, or if you go take wives besides my pikin woman dem, no man dey with us; see, God na witness between me and you.”
Laban talk to Jacob say, “See dis heap, and see di pillar wey I don set between me and you.
Dis heap na witness, and di pillar na witness, say I no go pass dis heap to you, and say you no go pass dis heap and dis pillar to me, for harm.
Make di God of Abraham, and di God of Nahor, di God of dem papa, judge between us.” Jacob swear by di Fear of im papa Isaac.
Jacob offer sacrifice for di mountain, and call im relatives to eat bread. Dem eat bread, and stay all night for di mountain.
Early for morning, Laban rise up, kiss im pikin dem and im pikin woman dem, and bless dem. Laban go, and return to im place.
Jacob go im way, and God angels meet am.
When Jacob see dem, e talk say, “Dis na God camp.” E call di name of dat place Mahanaim.
Jacob send messengers before am to Esau im brother for di land of Seir, di field of Edom.
E command dem say, “Una go talk so to my oga Esau: ‘Your servant Jacob talk say e don stay as foreigner with Laban, and e don dey dere till now.
E get cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. E don send to tell my oga, so that e go find favour for your sight.’”
Di messengers return to Jacob, talk say, “We come to your brother Esau. E dey come to meet you, and 400 men with am.”
Jacob fear well well and dey distressed. E divide di people wey dey with am, di flocks, di herds, and di camels into two companies.
E talk say, “If Esau come to one company, and strike am, di company wey remain go escape.”
Jacob talk say, “God of my papa Abraham, and God of my papa Isaac, di Lord, wey talk to me say, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I go do you good,’
I no worthy of di least of all di loving kindnesses, and of all di truth, wey you don show to your servant, because with only my staff I cross dis Jordan, and now I don become two companies.
Deliver me from di hand of my brother, from di hand of Esau, because I dey fear am, so that e no come strike me, di mama with di pikin dem.
You talk say, ‘I go surely do you good, and make your seed like di sand of di sea, wey no fit count for multitude.’”
E stay dere dat night, and take from wetin come to im hand, one present for Esau im brother:
200 female goats and 20 male goats, 200 ewes and 20 rams,
30 milking camels with dem pikin, 40 cows and ten bulls, 20 female donkeys and ten foals.
E deliver dem into di hand of im servants, every herd by itself, talk to im servants say, “Pass over before me, and put space between herd and herd.”
E command di first, say, “When Esau my brother meet you, and ask you, talk say, ‘Who be your oga? Wia you dey go? Whose be dem before you?’
Den you go talk say, ‘Dem na your servant Jacob own. Na present wey e send to my oga Esau. Look, e dey behind us too.’”
E command di second, di third, and all wey follow di herds, say, “Na so una go talk to Esau, when una find am.
Una go talk too, ‘Look, your servant Jacob dey behind us.’” Because e talk say, “I go appease am with di present wey go before me, and after dat I go see im face. Maybe e go accept me.”
So di present go over before am, and e imself stay dat night for di camp.
E rise up dat night, and take im two wives, im two servants, and im 11 pikin man dem, and cross di ford of Jabbok.
E take dem, and send dem over di stream, and send over wetin e get.
Jacob dey alone, and one man wrestle with am until di breaking of di day.
When e see say e no prevail against am, e touch di hollow of im thigh, and di hollow of Jacob thigh dislocate as e wrestle with am.
E talk say, “Make I go, because di day break.” E talk say, “I no go let you go, unless you bless me.”
E talk to am say, “Wetin be your name?” E talk say, “Jacob.”
E talk say, “Your name no go be Jacob again, but Israel, because you don fight with God and with men, and you don prevail.”
Jacob ask am, talk say, “Tell me your name.” E talk say, “Why you dey ask my name?” E bless am dere.
Jacob call di name of di place Peniel, say, “Because I don see God face to face, and my life dey preserved.”
Di sun rise on am as e pass over Peniel, and e dey limp because of im thigh.
Na why di pikin dem of Israel no dey eat di sinew of di hip wey dey di hollow of di thigh to dis day, because e touch di hollow of Jacob thigh, even di sinew of di hip.
Jacob lift up im eyes, and look, and see Esau dey come, and 400 men with am. E divide di pikin dem to Leah, to Rachel, and to di two servants.
E put di servants and dem pikin dem first, Leah and im pikin dem next, and Rachel and Joseph last.
E imself pass over before dem, and bow imself to di ground seven times, until e come near to im brother.
Esau run to meet am, embrace am, fall on im neck, kiss am, and dem weep.
E lift up im eyes, and see di women and di pikin dem, talk say, “Who be dem wey dey with you?” E talk say, “Di pikin dem wey God don graciously give your servant.”
Den di servants come near, dem and dem pikin dem, and dem bow down.
Leah too with im pikin dem come near, and bow down. After dat Joseph come near with Rachel, and dem bow down.
E talk say, “Wetin you mean by all dis company wey I meet?” E talk say, “To find favour for di eyes of my oga.”
Esau talk say, “I get enough, my brother. Keep wetin you get for yourself.”
Jacob talk say, “No, if now I don find favour for your sight, receive my present from my hand, because I don see your face, as though I don see God face, and you don receive me favourably.
Take my gift wey dem bring to you, because God don deal graciously with me, and because I get enough.” E press am, and e take am.
E talk say, “Make we go on our journey, and I go go before you.”
E talk to am say, “My oga know say di pikin dem tender, and say di flocks and herds wey dey nurse dey with me. If dem drive dem hard one day, all di flocks go die.
Make my oga pass over before im servant. I go lead on slowly, according to di pace of di livestock wey dey before me and according to di pace of di pikin dem, until I come to my oga for Seir.”
Esau talk say, “Make I leave some of di people wey dey with me with you.” E talk say, “Why e go be so? Make I find favour for di sight of my oga.”
Esau return dat day on im way to Seir.
Jacob journey go Succoth, build one house for imself, and make shelters for im livestock. Na why dem call di name of di place Succoth.
Jacob come in peace to di city of Shechem, wey dey di land of Canaan, when e come from Paddan Aram, and e camp before di city.
E buy di parcel of di field wia e don pitch im tent, from di hand of di pikin dem of Hamor, Shechem papa, for 100 pieces of money.
E set up one altar dere, and call am El Elohe Israel.
Dinah, di pikin woman of Leah, wey e born to Jacob, go out to see di pikin woman dem of di land.
Shechem di pikin of Hamor di Hivite, di prince of di land, see am. E take am, lie with am, and defile am.
Shechem soul cling to Dinah, di pikin woman of Jacob, and e love di young woman, and speak kindly to di young woman.
Shechem talk to im papa Hamor say, “Get dis girl for me to be wife.”
Now Jacob hear say Shechem don defile im pikin woman Dinah. Im pikin man dem dey with im livestock for di field. Jacob hold im peace until dem come.
Hamor di papa of Shechem go out to Jacob to talk with am.
Jacob pikin man dem come in from di field when dem hear am. Di men grieve, and dem vex well well, because e don do outrageous thing for Israel by lying with Jacob pikin woman, wey no suppose happen.
Hamor talk with dem say, “Di soul of my pikin Shechem long for your pikin woman. Make una give am to am to be wife.
Make una intermarry with us. Give your pikin woman dem to us, and take our pikin woman dem to una.
Una go dwell with us, and di land go dey before una. Dwell and trade for am, and get possessions for am.”
Shechem talk to Dinah papa and to im brothers, “Make I find favour for your eyes, and wetin una talk to me I go give.
Ask me for plenty dowry and gift, and I go give according to wetin una talk to me, but give me di young woman to be wife.”
Jacob pikin man dem answer Shechem and Hamor im papa with deceit, and talk, because e don defile Dinah dem sister,
and dem talk to dem say, “We no fit do dis thing, to give our sister to one man wey no circumcise, because dat na reproach to us.
Only on dis condition we go consent to una: if una go be as we be, say every male among una go circumcise,
we go give our pikin woman dem to una, and we go take una pikin woman dem to us, and we go dwell with una, and we go become one people.
But if una no listen to us, to be circumcise, we go take our pikin woman, and go.”
Dem words good for di eyes of Hamor and Shechem, Hamor pikin.
Di young man no delay to do di thing, because e delight for Jacob pikin woman. E dey most honoured of all im papa house.
Hamor and Shechem im pikin come to di gate of dem city, and talk to di men of dem city say,

“Dem men dey peaceful with us. Make dem dwell for di land and trade for am, because look, di land big enough for dem. Make we take dem pikin woman dem to us for wives, and make we give our pikin woman dem to dem.
Only on dis condition di men go consent to us to dwell with us, to become one people: say every male among us go circumcise, as dem dey circumcise.
Dem livestock and dem property and all dem animals no go be our own? Only make we consent to dem, and dem go dwell with us.”
All wey go out of di gate of im city listen to Hamor and to Shechem im pikin, and every male circumcise, all wey go out of di gate of im city.
E come be say for di third day, when dem dey sore, two of Jacob pikin man dem, Simeon and Levi, Dinah brothers, take each man im sword, come on di city unsuspecting, and kill all di males.
Dem kill Hamor and Shechem im pikin with di edge of di sword, take Dinah out of Shechem house, and go out.
Jacob pikin man dem come on di dead, and plunder di city, because dem don defile dem sister.
Dem take dem flocks, dem herds, dem donkeys, and wetin dey di city, and wetin dey di field,
and all dem wealth. Dem carry away captive all dem little ones and dem wives, and plunder all wey dey for di houses.

Jacob talk to Simeon and Levi, “Una don trouble me, to make me odious among di inhabitants of di land, among di Canaanites and di Perizzites. I get few men, and dem go gather together against me and strike me, and I go dey destroyed, I and my house.”
Dem talk say, “Make e treat our sister like prostitute?”
